numerical_recomputation.notes: The deterministic model demonstrates mount-prefix selection and operation-table dispatch only; it excludes real paths, references, locks, credentials, caching, I/O, networks, daemons, errors and durability.

evidence: Reviewed positive and negative dentries; hard-link aliases; unlinked open inodes; bind and idmapped mounts; independent and duplicated opens; cached and direct I/O; missing methods; partial progress; delayed errors; freeze, lazy and strict unmount; and stable-handle generations.
